title: Mega job fair held in Kupwara; over 1,600 youth connect with 30 employers

ai.summary: A job fair in Kupwara, Kashmir, connected over 1,600 youth with 30 employers from across Kashmir and India, aiming to strengthen local employment opportunities amid the district's developmental challenges.

facts.claim: over 1,600 youth from Kupwara and adjoining areas
facts.quote: The event received an encouraging response, with more than 1,600 youth from Kupwara and adjoining areas registering and attending the fair.

facts.claim: 30 employers from across Kashmir and India
facts.quote: The job fair witnessed participation from over 30 employers from across Kashmir, while several reputed companies from different parts of the country joined virtually.
